% The math font of a document in Computer Modern, Latin Modern Math, with
% the PDF's alphabets, accents, and dots: \mathbb in AMS's msbm, \mathcal
% and its bold in cmsy's design, accents over letters placed with New
% Computer Modern's skews, a √ in text on the baseline, in a line no
% deeper than others, over a fraction bar, and with a subscript, and dots
% spaced as TeX spaces them, also when \dots chooses them. Then the dots
% in a subscript, where TeX drops their thin spaces, and in a matrix, wide
% accents in two of TeX's sizes, a \Bigg[, a display integral, and a cases
% brace in cmex's sizes and glyphs, braces built from cmex's pieces,
% arrows over letters as wide as the letters, a \big arrow, a \Big double
% arrow, and a \Big\lgroup built from pieces as TeX builds them,
% parentheses in two of cmex's sizes, and bars as tall as TeX builds them,
% as wide as cmex's and cmsy's.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,textcomp}
\begin{document}
Alphabets: $\mathbb{R}$, $\mathcal{A}$, and $\boldsymbol{\mathcal{A}}$.

Accents: $\hat a$, $\hat x$, $\vec a$, $\hat A$, $\hat{\mathsf A}$, $\hat{\mathtt E}$,
$\hat{\mathfrak A}$, $\hat{\mathbb A}$, and $\hat{\boldsymbol{\mathsf{\Sigma}}}$.

Text: $\text{\textsurd}$ and $\text{\textbf{\textsurd}}$ on one line.

Over a bar and with a subscript: $\frac{\text{\textsurd}}{2}$ and $\text{\textsurd}_2$.

Dots: $1,2,\ldots,n$, $a+\cdots+b$, $1,\dots,n$, $a+\dots+b$, and
$x_{1,\ldots,n}$.
\[ \begin{pmatrix} 1 & \cdots & 0 \\ \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ 0 & \cdots & 1 \end{pmatrix} \]
Wide accents: $\widehat{ab}$ and $\widetilde{xyz}$.
Large sizes: $E\Bigg[\min\Bigl(\frac{2|tX|^m}{m!},1\Bigr)\Bigg]$, an integral,
\[ \int p(y_{n+1}\mid y_1,\dots,y_n)\,dy_{n+1}, \]
and a brace:
\[ f(x) = \begin{cases} \dfrac{a}{b}, & x > 0, \\ 0, & x \le 0. \end{cases} \]
Braces and arrows: $\underbrace{a+b+c}_{n}$, $\overbrace{x+y+z}^{m}$,
$\overrightarrow{AB}$, $\overleftarrow{AB}$, and $\big\uparrow\Big\Downarrow\Big\lgroup$.
Parentheses: $\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)$ and $\begin{pmatrix} a \\ b \end{pmatrix}$.
Bars: $P(A \bigm| B)$, $\left\| \frac{a}{b} \right\|$,
$\mathbb{E}\Bigl\|\nabla f\Bigr\|_2^2$, and $\lVert y-\bar y\rVert^2$.
\end{document}
